This year, we're excited to unveil three new maps: [[Abyss]], [[Katla]], and [[Sanctuary]] — each bringing its own set of fresh challenges, and strategic complexities.   Releasing on November 19th, players have a brief but crucial period to learn and master these new arenas. While Prewar stands as a fierce battle of skills in its own right, keep an eye on these maps — for there may come a time when knowing them through and through is beneficial... === Format === * Single-Elimination Bracket ** {{Abbr|BO5}} matches ** All 3 maps must be played first, where losing player picks a potential 4th map, and the remaining player picks the 5th == Prize pool == The three
